item.title: YTKillerPlus v21.38.2
item.description:
YouTube 21.38.2 | YTKillerPlus_21.38.2_6.1
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
- **Cracked by** [u/lowiqentity](https://www.reddit.com/user/lowiqentity/)
> [!NOTE] > - **Sidestore is no longer supported!!.** > - **YTUHD** is not included. > - use **YTKACE or any other mod** for downloading. dev intentionally broke download feature. > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`
> [!WARNING] > - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
